comments.author: @RemoteEarthJourneys
comments.text:
It’s wild to think an entire community can function with only around 30 people. What surprised me most wasn’t how remote Palmerston is—it was how much every single person matters. A teacher, a fisherman, a child, or one family leaving can actually change the future of the island.
Do you think you could build a life in a place this small and isolated, or would you eventually have to leave?
If remote communities like Palmerston fascinate you, watch our next story here:  https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLyqtHXpFgXgXv8MdTdpCdlCv3E7oqGvYF

comments.text: What an absolute masterpiece of a documentary! Watching this made me re-evaluate what 'community' really means. In big cities, we're surrounded by millions yet often feel completely disconnected. The struggle for the younger generation between wanting broader opportunities and preserving their roots really hit home. Thank you for making such a thoughtful film! 🌴🙏
